question: Interspecific interaction between two species, in which both members benefit, is referred to as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**mutualism**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An **interspecific interaction where both members benefit i**s called mutualism. 
 
• Mutualism is a **symbiotic relationship where both species involved gain a positive advantag**e from their interaction with each other. 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Bees pollinating flowers while collecting nectar - the bees get food and the flowers get pollinated.
